name: PR brief renders the seeded cached read path
description: From the app root, open the seeded PR #482 and, on the default Overview tab, assert the seeded PR brief's cached read path: the merge-risk band, the live blocker count on the review's counts badge, a seeded risk title from RiskList, a seeded review-focus row's reason, the generated-from footer's short head sha, the cost/token line, and the cross-model note naming both the brief's model and the review's model. Then open the Files changed tab and assert the seeded core file src/middleware/ratelimit.ts's pseudocode_summary text. Exercises GET /pulls/:id/brief and GET /pulls/:id/smart-diff purely as cached reads — no step presses Generate or Regenerate, matching e2e/README.md's no-LLM, no-Playwright, no-API-key rule (mirrors why 09-project-context never presses 'Compute intent'). NOTE — this flow deliberately does not assert the 'Review focus' or 'What this does' LABELS by their literal text: both are rendered through a span with CSS `textTransform: uppercase` (SectionLabel's title span; SmartDiffGroup's fileSummaryLabel), and a hermetic run proved `wait --text "Review focus"` times out against that rendered element — see e2e/INSIGHTS.md. Each label's presence is instead proven by its seeded row/summary CONTENT, which sits in a plain (non-transformed) span next to it, and is the more meaningful assertion regardless. NOTE — no step clicks src/middleware/ratelimit.ts's FileCard header: it renders already expanded, because it carries no findings (its file_summaries sibling in this seed is src/config.ts, not it) and its 84 changed lines sit under FileCard's AUTO_EXPAND_MAX_LINES (200) fallback threshold (`FileCard.tsx` defaultOpen useState), so shouldDefaultOpen (SmartDiffViewer/helpers.ts) returns undefined and the line-count fallback opens it on mount; a click here would toggle it CLOSED — see e2e/INSIGHTS.md. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
